performance.verdict: Meta dark 3 days; intake pipeline has zero opps — money stopped, CRM never worked.

findings.text: Meta has been $0 spend for 3 consecutive days (Sep 9–11); channel_dark confirmed. Zero leads in that window vs. 3/day July target.
⛔ Extension with Marwan unsigned as of 2026-08-31; engagement is month-to-month lapsed — all paid activity is ungated and at risk.
⛔ SMS automation and Zoho Voice access both overdue since 2026-08-31; contact rate is the stated bottleneck yet CRM tooling remains unresolved.
GHL shows 0 opportunities created from 24 contacts over 28 days — leads are arriving but none converting to pipeline; this is an intake leak, not an ads problem.
28-day CPL is $46.95 against an active-period low of ~$19/wk in July — efficiency has deteriorated 2.5× from best observed baseline during the current campaign.

suggestions.text: Restore Meta spend to $65/day immediately; 3 zero-spend days confirmed killing all lead volume.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta has been completely dark Sep 9–11 (confirmed $0 spend, 0 leads), halting all pipeline input for the 'Leads - August Re-Launch' campaign. Restore the daily budget to $65/day as soon as Marwan's extension status is confirmed with Sohib. Success check: at least 3 leads recorded in GHL within 48 hours of reactivation. Re-check 2026-09-15.

suggestions.text: Repair GHL intake: 0 opportunities from 24 contacts is a CRM workflow failure, not an ads problem — fix pipeline stage trigger.
suggestions.monday_update: Over the last 28 days, 24 contacts entered GHL and 0 opportunities were created — the pipeline stage trigger is either missing or broken. Nacer/CRM team to audit the GHL workflow and confirm the contact-to-opportunity automation is firing correctly. Success check: new contacts from the next Meta burst appear as opportunities within 1 hour of form submission. Confirm fix by 2026-09-15.

suggestions.text: Watch CPL vs $19 July baseline; do not scale above $65/day until CPL returns below $35 for 3 consecutive days.
suggestions.monday_update: 28-day CPL is $46.95, roughly 2.5× the July best-week baseline of ~$19. The current campaign pause makes trend analysis unreliable until Meta is live again. Hold spend at $65/day and do not approve a scale action until CPL drops below $35 for 3 straight days. Re-check 2026-09-18.
